title: 第853章 三战二第852章 三战一
content_zh:
第853章三战（二）
严永歌这一枪，汇聚了她数百年战力大成，仿佛要将苍穹捅出一个窟窿。
她自信，哪怕是大修士，面对这一枪，也不敢硬撼。
雷秋雪身影一闪，已经原地消失。
再次出现，已然到了严永歌头顶，心剑一剑斩出。
好快！好冷！
严永歌心头一凛，对方实在快得有些吓人！
这一剑，表面平平无奇，却有种让人心寒之感。
她不敢硬撼，闪身躲避。
脚下白云被切成两半，空间出现一道细小的真空气缝，从千丈高空，直压而落。
轰隆隆！
脚下山脉，被割出一道裂谷，深不见底。
围观者全都脸色微变，这一剑之威，也着实太恐怖了吧！
这可是千丈之高啊！这剑芒的速度、威力，有些不合常理啊！
沈青媚震惊地看向张扬，总算明白这家伙，为什么一副胸有成竹的样子。
张扬暗暗松了口气，他早就猜到雷秋雪实力很强，只是没想到会强到这种地步，不愧是转世者。
“我说过，一旦我出手，你连还手的机会都没有。”
雷秋雪再次使用雷遁术，瞬移到严永歌侧面，一剑斩出。
我就不信，挡不住。
这一次，严永歌没有选择躲避，而是正面硬撼。

魔枪斩出一道滔天枪芒，迎了上去。
枪芒声势浩大，风起云涌，化成一条庞然巨兽，瞬间将雷秋雪的剑芒吞噬掉。
然而，下一刻，庞然巨兽的身体猛然被切开，那道被吞噬的剑芒没有消失，而是在枪芒内部将它摧毁。
余威不减，狠狠朝严永歌劈去。
严永歌接连布了几道防御，才终于将剑芒破掉。
此时此刻，她内心涌起一阵绝望，这是她这辈子都没有过的。
雷的速度、雷的穿透力，两者合一，仿佛这世界上就没有对方攻不破的。
“永歌，结阵。”
下方的魔族大统领脸色严峻起来，千里传音。
严永歌闻言，右手一甩，五支魔枪出现，与她手中魔枪，组成一个威力巨大的大阵。一个黑到几乎实质化的光罩，将她护在中心。远远看去，天空像是悬浮着一颗巨大的黑色珠子。
魔族大统领不敢再看戏，目光瞬间锁定张扬，身上燃起滔天魔焰。
他要出手了。
刹那间，无数魔焰，化为黑眶赤瞳的巨大火鸦，铺天盖地朝张扬袭来。
“师侄顶住，我先解决那军师。”
沈青媚说完，身影如同鬼魅般出击，瞬间锁定军师。
张扬则将断剑祭出，瞬间变身混沌兽，领域施展。
他深知这将是自己遇到的最强大的敌人，也将是惨烈一战。
就看他跟严永歌之间，谁能防到最后。
魔焰黑鸦刚进入领域，速度就变慢起来。
张扬剑芒劈出，道道血色剑芒，尽数将黑鸦斩杀。

魔族大统领瞬移到血雾边沿，身体化成一把魔刀，竟生生从领域中劈了进去。周围的血雾遭遇如此恐怖的攻击力，竟然无法聚拢，生生在领域中，被生生杀出一条血路。
content_en:
Chapter 853 Three Battles (2)
Yan Yongge's spear, which had gathered hundreds of years of her combat power, seemed to be poking a hole in the sky.
She was confident that even a great monk would not dare to attack this shot.
Lei Qiuxue's figure flashed and disappeared on the spot.
He appeared again, already at the top of Yan Yongge's head, and slashed out with his heart sword.
So fast! So cold!
Yan Yongge's heart trembled, the opponent was so fast!
This sword looks ordinary on the surface, but it has a chilling feeling.
She didn't dare to attack hard and ducked away.
The white clouds under my feet were cut in half, and a small vacuum gap appeared in the space, falling directly from a thousand feet in the sky.
Boom!
A rift was cut out of the mountains at the foot of the mountain, which was bottomless.
The faces of the onlookers all changed slightly. The power of this sword was really terrifying!
This is thousands of feet high! The speed and power of this sword light are a bit unreasonable!
Shen Qingmei looked at Zhang Yang in shock, finally understanding why this guy looked so confident.
Zhang Yang secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He had already guessed that Lei Qiuxue was very strong, but he didn't expect that he would be so strong. He was worthy of being a reincarnation.
"I said once I take action, you won't even have a chance to fight back."
Lei Qiuxue used the Thunder Escape Technique again, teleported to the side of Yan Yongge, and slashed out with a sword.
I don't believe it, I can't stop it.
This time, Yan Yongge did not choose to evade, but faced him head-on.
The magic spear slashed out a monstrous spear light and rushed forward.
The gun light was so powerful that it turned into a gigantic beast and instantly swallowed up Lei Qiuxue's sword light.
However, the next moment, the body of the huge beast was suddenly cut open, and the swallowed sword light did not disappear, but destroyed it inside the gun light.
His power remained undiminished, and he struck hard at Yan Yongge.
Yan Yongge deployed several defenses one after another before finally breaking through the sword light.
At this moment, she felt a sense of despair in her heart, something she had never experienced in her life.
The speed of thunder and the penetrating power of thunder are combined into one, as if there is no opponent in the world that cannot be defeated.
"Yongge, form a formation."
The demon leader below had a serious look on his face and sent a message from thousands of miles away.
Upon hearing this, Yan Yongge flicked her right hand, and five magic spears appeared, forming a powerful formation with the magic spears in her hand. A mask of light that was so black that it was almost substantial protected her in the center. From a distance, it looks like a huge black bead is suspended in the sky.
The leader of the demon clan did not dare to watch the show anymore, his eyes instantly locked on Zhang Yang, and his body was ignited with demonic flames.
He's going to take action.
In an instant, countless demonic flames turned into huge fire crows with black eyes and red eyes, overwhelmingly attacking Zhang Yang.
"Master nephew, hold on, I'll deal with the military advisor first."
After Shen Qingmei finished speaking, her figure struck out like a ghost, locking onto the military advisor instantly.
Zhang Yang sacrificed the broken sword and instantly transformed into a Chaos Beast, performing domain effects.
He knew that this would be the most powerful enemy he had ever encountered, and it would also be a brutal battle.
It just depends on who can defend him to the end between him and Yan Yongge.
As soon as the Demon Flame Black Crow entered the domain, its speed slowed down.
Zhang Yang's sword light slashed out, and the bloody sword light killed all the black crows.
The leader of the demon tribe teleported to the edge of the blood mist, and his body turned into a magic knife, which actually slashed through the realm. The surrounding blood mist encountered such a terrifying attack force that it was unable to gather together, and everyone was killed in the field.
